video_prompt: One continuous horizontal full-frame shot from the first frame to the last, filmed on a phone front camera on a tripod. The woman — a woman about 27 years old with warm light-brown skin and long loose wavy dark-brown hair with soft caramel ends, falling over both shoulders, small gold hoop earrings, wearing a plain cream-colored crewneck sweater — sits alone in a bright cozy bedroom with warm white walls, a light oak wooden headboard with white linen pillows behind her on the right, a small bedside table with a ceramic lamp glowing warmly and a green potted plant, a woven wall basket decoration on the left wall, soft daylight from a window, and stays exactly the same person the whole time: same face, same hair, same sweater, same position in the frame, same distance from the camera. The camera stays still and the room around her stays still and calm. She talks straight into the camera, sincere and a little worried, like confiding in a friend, with small natural head movements and small nods; her shoulders stay relaxed and her face stays centered in the frame.
